summary: Collections need a separate sanity ignore file per Ansible release, named tests/sanity/ignore-X.Y.txt, so they can pass tests across multiple versions.
questions: Where do I put sanity ignores in my collection?
Why do collections have multiple ignore files?

answer_card.title: Collection ignore file location
answer_card.answer_md: Use `tests/sanity/ignore-X.Y.txt`, where X.Y is the ansible-core release you test with. Keep one per release so the collection passes on several versions.
